summary: Wow congrats! Made me feel so much better. Ended up shutting down Facebook..... Wish I would have exported to json so I could use @cleverdevil Known importer plugin. I am still on Twitter. Such a strong network for teachers. Loving the social readers.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Wow congrats! Made me feel so much better. Ended up shutting down Facebook..... Wish I would have exported to json so I could use @cleverdevil Known importer plugin.

I am still on Twitter. Such a strong network for teachers.

Loving the social readers.
